author: Wanda Wilson Dooley
text: The main issue with putting them someplace other than what the research has said is the site to use (back of arm), is that if it isn't accurate or completely fails, you have nobody to blame. Many of the people who are awakened with compression lows during the night have placed the sensor on the side of their arm, not the back of the arm. Site prep and placement is key to it working well. Good luck.
